text:
Alex K: Thinking we compress the weekly triage to 15m starting next week. Proposed agenda (15m): - 3m quick bug census + top priority - 6m owner assignment for hot items - 6m any blocking RFC/design asks. Who's ok with 15m and brief pre-read?
Mira Patel: Fine with 15m if people update the 'ready-for-sync' label or the doc before the meeting. Can we move it to Tue 09:30 instead of Wed?
Samir Rao: Agree on 15m. Also propose we move low-priority backlog items to an async "board walk" thread so meeting stays tight.
Jordan Li: Quick ask — can we standardize owner assignment? I can make a tiny form to pick owner + confidence (low/med/high).
Alex K: SG. Doc link (placeholder): https://docs.internal/redwood/bug-census. Example payload I used for the form:
```json
{ "bug_id": "", "owner": "", "confidence": "low/med/high", "notes": "" }
```
Devex Bot: Poll created — vote: Tue 09:30 / Wed 10:00 / Thu 09:00. Please vote by EOD Fri :ballot_box_with_check:
Mira Patel: Also propose a rule: if a bug has no owner after 48h assign on-call as interim. Can add an opt-out for infra/outage tickets that shouldn't auto-assign.
Samir Rao: Fine with that, but please add the opt-out label so we avoid noisy assignments. I'll add it to the board.
Jordan Li: I'll build the opt-out label + automation this afternoon; should be quick.
Alex K: Thanks. If poll lands on Tue I'll shrink the calendar invites to 15m and add pre-read checklist in the description. After meeting, please put notes in #eng/meeting-notes so async folks can follow up.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: on-call rotation this week: Mira -> Samir (starts Mon).
Mira Patel: :thumbsup: I'll start the pre-read doc and ping owners for updates.
